topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I was sorting through the old, dusty books in the attic, stacking them neatly, when I stumbled upon a stack of handwritten pages. The cover read, "His Shadow, Her Light." My fingers traced the title, a title so evocative, so intimate. I couldn't help but open it. Inside, the stories were woven with details only someone close could know. There I was, in the lines, as the protagonist's shadow, deep and complex. The description was so vivid, so layered, it made my heart race. I found myself flipping through the pages, hungry to understand why, wondering what this meant for us.
